|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce-original.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1760f9c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/yodamasteroftheforce.gif Holotable commit 1760f9c “directory name change (first added the same day in commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”)”], no mark). Text: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to a battleground site as a regular move. Immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V) (Errata)]], 17 December 2020): Players Committee card image, 17 December 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce-icon-2020.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0df3cc9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/yodamasteroftheforce.gif Holotable commit 0df3cc9 “Updates”], no mark). Text: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to a battleground site as a regular move. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the icon at top left is now a lightsaber icon (the original showed the Rebel Alliance emblem); same words. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce-E-2021.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/yodamasteroftheforce.png Holotable commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata”], mark “E”). Text: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to an [Episode I] battleground site as a regular move. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' “relocate to a battleground site” became “relocate to an [Episode I] battleground site”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce-20210318-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V) (Errata 3)]], 27 November 2021): Players Committee card image, 27 November 2021: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/989ae51/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/yodamasteroftheforce.png Holotable commit 989ae51 “Errata images”], mark “E2”). Text: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to an [Episode I] battleground site as a regular move (for free). Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' “as a regular move” became “as a regular move (for free)”. (The Set 13 remaster of 2 January 2023 is pixel-identical, not a separate version. The PC card data never added “(for free)”; this page follows the printed card.) '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E2”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
